status: post-hoc assistant-coded sensitivity map; not independent human validation
scope: All 52 strict canonical entity names already present in the frozen coding inventory. Mapping changes analysis resolution, not the original C/M/R judgments or source transcripts.
rules: Strict names and original coding remain the primary frozen inventory.

Family is an explicitly listed branded product-line sensitivity grouping, not a universal corporate-parent identity. Different services of a large provider remain separate (Google Analytics, Google Sheets, Google Search Console).
Family grouping does not establish equivalent products, versions, prices or capabilities; unspecified aliases remain unspecified in the strict lens.
Category grouping is deliberately coarse and can mechanically increase overlap. It is not evidence of greater recommendation stability.
Category-filtered analyses retain strict names and original per-answer recommendation decisions. Channel discussion is not automatically recommendation or publication advice.
Question-supplied targets, generic methods and source-publisher-only observations remain excluded by the original codebook.

categories.geo_visibility_product: Specialized GEO visibility or readiness offering
categories.general_measurement_tool: General measurement, analytics or recordkeeping tool
categories.research_or_publication_channel: Research, evidence, review or publication channel
categories.other_ai_surface_or_feature: Other AI surface, model or retrieval feature
